rejection_findings.finding: The replacement omits the accepted claim and relation citations required to support its source-grounded account of purity, truth, and value.

revisions.body: The comparison with pure whiteness changes the criterion of superiority. The strongest pleasure is not automatically the best; purity, truth, and proportion now do the evaluative work. The later ranking will depend on this quieter standard.
